channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: JetBlue ending Vero Beach to JFK route in September, citing low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Murray Middle School demolition underway in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition has begun at Murray Middle School in Martin County as the district moves forward with a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage from Hurricane Milton. item.description:

item.description: A Palm Beach County man led Martin County deputies on a high-speed chase through Indiantown after driving more than 100 mph on State Road 710, one of the area's most dangerous roads. item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff ramps up traffic enforcement with crackdown on speeding
item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is deploying additional deputies this summer to reduce speeding and reckless driving. Deputies have conducted more than 1,000 traffic stops in four weeks.

item.title: Messi to face Yamal in World Cup final after bathing him as baby
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort's 2007 images of teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal for a charity calendar have gone viral before Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two late goals to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinal, with Enzo Fernandez equalizing in the 85th minute and Lautaro Martinez heading in the winner in stoppage time.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday to prevent the tablets from running artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final at New Jersey stadium Sunday
item.description: A sprawling network of federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies continue with a game plan two years in the making to ensure Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain is safe.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs low-altitude Blue Angels flyover at Pensacola beach as safety review halted
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended a low-altitude Blue Angels flyover that scattered beach chairs and tents at a crowded Pensacola beach Wednesday, marking the third time he has intervened to halt safety investigations of controversial military flight maneuvers. item.title: Leon County jury orders Florida Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 in sexual harassment case
item.description: A Leon County jury found Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation, ordering him to pay $450,000 to former legislative aides and a parent.

item.title: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon set for September trial on charges stemming from DeSantis office sit-in
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office protesting Florida's congressional map.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces court hearing over Florida residency requirement
item.description: A two-day hearing beginning July 21 will determine whether gubernatorial candidate James Fishback meets Florida's seven-year residency requirement after opponent Lt. Jay Collins challenged his eligibility.

item.title: Fentanyl summit in Orlando draws teens, DEA chief and families affected by synthetic opioid crisis
item.description: Students from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and DEA Administrator Terrance Cole at the Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando this week.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers homeowners rates by average of 5.6% for Florida customers
item.description: Security First Insurance is reducing homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6%, the latest in a series of decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Everglades detention facility Alligator Alcatraz completely dismantled one month after closure announcement
item.description: Alligator Alcatraz, which held undocumented immigrants in the Everglades for about a year, has been completely dismantled after Gov. Ron DeSantis announced last month it would shut down.

item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters and adopters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast providing free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying residents in Martin County.

item.title: Jonathan Dickinson State Park concession closure leaves visitors without boats and tours
item.description: Jonathan Dickinson State Park's concession operation is closed indefinitely this summer, leaving visitors without access to boat rentals, canoe rentals, and the popular Loxahatchee Queen tour to Trapper Nelson's Island.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: A Hobe Sound couple is asking for community support as they navigate a cancer diagnosis, holding onto faith every step of the way.

item.title: FDOT to Hold Public Workshops on Willoughby Boulevard Improvement Study
item.description: The Florida Department of Transportation will hold two public workshops to discuss proposed improvements along Willoughby Boulevard between Monterey Road and U.S. 1 in Martin Count

item.title: Dale Mincey charged with first-degree murder in shooting death of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Barnes
item.description: Dale Mincey, 41, was formally charged with first-degree murder Saturday in the fatal shooting of his uncle, 66-year-old Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes. Karen Moye, Barnes' sister, also faces charges for providing false information to investigators.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman claims $5 million lottery prize from scratch-off ticket bought on Okeechobee Road
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, claimed a $5 million top prize from a scratch-off game on April 6 and chose to receive her winnings as a lump-sum payment of $3,262,138.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return home after nearly two years following structural damage evacuation
item.description: Some Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of being displaced after structural damage in August 2024 forced evacuations from buildings 3, 4, and 5.

item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over Causeway Cove high-rise development proposal
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project Monday, which includes five high-rise buildings, including a 17-story building standing 192 feet tall off Seaway Drive.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights rezoning of lot behind home near Crosstown Parkway and SW Fairgreen Drive
item.description: Joseph and Margaret Mucciolo are searching for answers after the Port St. Lucie City Council voted unanimously to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, despite their months-long opposition.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District extinguishes Ford F-250 fire on Florida's Turnpike near Mile Marker 175
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District crews responded to a vehicle fire Monday morning on Florida's Turnpike Northbound near Mile Marker 175, finding a fully involved Ford F-250 pickup truck on the shoulder.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff deploys extra deputies to combat speeding on Midway Road, U.S. 1, Indian River Drive
item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer by deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county. item.title: Applications open for free and reduced-price school meals in Indian River County
item.description: Families in Indian River County can apply starting July 15 for free or reduced-price meals for students during the 2026-2027 school year.
